scope: NFL regular seasons 1970-1980: teams, conferences, divisions, records, postseason

conventions.city/name: as Pro-Football-Reference lists the team that season
conventions.abbreviation: project display convention, not a historical claim
conventions.team order: final standings order within the division: the order PFR lists, except four ties the NFL's official standings break differently (1974 AFC East, 1976 NFC West, 1977 AFC East, 1977 AFC Central), which follow the NFL Record & Fact Book (see order_note on those divisions)
conventions.finish: division_winner / wild_card / null, from PFR standings marks
conventions.season: the season year; the Super Bowl is played the following January

playoff_format.qualification: Three division winners plus the non-division winner with the best record in each conference (Pro Football Hall of Fame).
playoff_format.home_field: Predetermined rotation among divisions, regardless of record (Pro Football Hall of Fame: the rotation was dropped in 1975).
playoff_format.same_division_rule: A wild card could not meet its own division winner in the divisional round (NFL Record & Fact Book: from 1970 to 1989 two teams from the same division could not meet before the conference championship game; consistent with every PFR divisional matchup 1970-1977).

playoff_format.qualification: Three division winners plus two wild cards per conference; the two wild cards play each other in the first round (Pro Football Hall of Fame).
playoff_format.home_field: Seeded by record; the higher-seeded wild card hosts the Wild Card game (Wikipedia cross-check). PFR game sites agree wherever the two wild cards had different records. The two equal-record cases were settled by tiebreakers, per the NFL Record & Fact Book: 1978 NFC, Atlanta was first wild card over Philadelphia (both 9-7) on record against common opponents (5-2 to 5-3); 1980 AFC, Oakland was first wild card over Houston (both 11-5) on conference record (9-3 to 7-5). The general tiebreak procedure was not researched.
playoff_format.same_division_rule: Teams from the same division could not meet in the divisional round (NFL Record & Fact Book: from 1970 to 1989 two teams from the same division could not meet before the conference championship game; consistent with every PFR divisional matchup 1978-1980).
